messages:
eli: Heads-up: Product wants to retire the legacy header `X-Partner-Token` across Partner API. Proposed public announcement 2025-04-07, enforcement 2025-06-07 (60 days). Need partner coordination, marketplace listing update, and SI runbooks.

maria: Do we have telemetry showing current partner usage? we should size the impact before sending wide notice.

chad: I can pull weekly usage by org and list top 30 orgs using the old header. will share CSV by EOD.

vikram: Recommendation: ship a maintenance SDK (compat) that accepts both headers for one minor release and emits a deprecation warning to logs/console. SDK versioning: publish 3.2.0-compat.

tess (partner-eng): For partners that came through marketplace, we need a separate notice in the listing changelog + an optional migration guide tile in the listing UI. Also ask marketplace team for a soft-banner.

eli: Good call. Marketplace listing needs: short explanation, migration steps, and a flag indicating whether partner integrations will break without action. Avoid scaring end customers; phrasing should be "security header standardization" for public UI. For partner emails be explicit about break potential.

maria: On telemetry: chad, can you add a field for "last_seen_old_header_ts" so we can target stale integrators?

chad: yes. Also adding metric: partners.deprecation.old_header_active_orgs and a per-org counter.

vikram: Can we provide partner-side test tokens? I'll add a feature that issues scoped sandbox tokens that mirror production rate limits for the canary partners.

tess (partner-eng): We should pick 4 pilot partners across different integration types: marketplace app, SI-managed, and direct API integrator. Any suggestions?

eli: Suggestion: Atlas Systems (marketplace), BlueBox SI (integration partner), and two direct customers: NovaApps + CurioLabs. I'll DM legal for contact approvals.

marketplace-bot: Listing update draft scheduled: 2025-04-02T12:00Z. Reminder: marketplace changelog requires 72h review window.

maria: Draft partner advisory should include: migration snippet, testing checklist, rollback guidance, and support SLA for migration requests. Also a CSV of partner owners from tess.

chad: Migration snippet for docs: 
```
# before
X-Partner-Token: <token>
# after
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Add curl, python-requests, and node examples. Note: some SDKs previously accepted `token` query param 90s ago; call that out.

vikram: Canary plan: enable enforcement for whitelisted orgs on 2025-05-01, monitor errors for 7 days, then widen. I'll produce runbook: steps to enable, validate, rollback.

tess (partner-eng): Action items: 1) I'll export partner contacts & marketplace mapping by Tue EOD. 2) @chad produce org usage CSV by EOD today. 3) @vikram prod sandbox token generator by next Mon. 4) @maria draft partner advisory + support escalation matrix by Thu.

eli: Also coordinate PR for SDK repos: compat branch -> publish 3.2.0-compat and schedule deprecation warnings. We should add a small telemetry header in responses to show migration progress (X-Deprecation-Status: legacy|migrated).

chad: I'll add that response header to the canary and compat routes. metric TTLs and retention will be 90d for this program.

marketplace-bot: Canary rollout preflight check: OK. Artifacts required: listing-changelog.md, partner-advisory.md, sdk-compat-release-tag.

vikram: For SIs: we need a short 'SI checklist' doc: update SDK in orchestrator, run smoke tests (auth, rate-limit, kv-cache), verify observability spans. I'll draft and send to tess.

maria: Question: what extension policy if a partner asks for more time? We can offer a 30-day extension for high-impact partners if they commit a migration schedule and join a paid migration assistance program. Need approvals from partnerships and legal.

eli: Approved in principle. Tess: collect requests and we'll triage. Also, ensure any extension whitelist is gated and temporary.

tess (partner-eng): Noted. I'll add an "extension_request" label in the tracker and include a required migration plan template.

chad: FYI I'm seeing a handful of marketplace integrations that only use client-side SDK bundles. Those will need an updated npm package and a new bundling notice in the listing. Will add to the marketplace copy.

eli: Let's meet Thurs 9:30a PT to finalize messaging. If anyone can't make it, drop blockers here. We should lock announcement copy 48h before publish.

marketplace-bot: Meeting scheduled: 2025-04-03 09:30 PT.

maria: I'll start a support-runbook thread in support channel with escalation numbers.

vikram: I'll prepare the canary automations: whitelist toggle, token issuer, and smoke test suite (auth + simple generate). Targeting first canary 2025-05-01.

eli: Great work. Once we have chad's org list and tess's contacts, I'll draft the partner advisory and send for legal/marketing review. Close loop after Thurs sync.
